detection_rule.paired_spread: For each signal/rung retain the median paired difference m and scaled MAD s=1.4826*median(abs(d-m)) across its retained frame pairs. A zero or undefined s is not evidence and cannot establish detection.
detection_rule.reliably_detected_displacement: A nonzero rung is reliably detected only when at least 30 retained frame pairs exist, s is positive and finite, abs(m) >= 3*s, and at least 80 percent of retained paired differences have the strict sign of m. In addition, the six nonzero-rung medians must be monotone from the 0-px baseline in that same direction across the whole 2,5,10,20,40,100 px ladder. This is a predeclared measurement criterion based on paired spread, not a fitted production threshold or an accuracy calculation.
detection_rule.monotonicity: Report every rung median and state whether the full nonzero ladder is nondecreasing or nonincreasing. Any signal failing that test is explicitly ineligible for a one-sided gate regardless of individual-rung effects.
